I ranked the pool using composition, symmetry and local bonding descriptors extracted from the POSCARs, combining regression estimates with close structural analogues in the training set. My selections are:

| Rank | Candidate | Material | Structural and training-data rationale |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | **c073** | CdIn₃Te₄As | A noncentrosymmetric **P1 tetrahedral framework**, closely analogous to training material ZnIn₃AsSe₄ (55.7 pm/V). The more polarizable telluride bonding supports a substantially larger response; the training data show strong Se→Te enhancement in related semiconductor families. |
| 2 | **c055** | AlGaAs₂ | An ordered **R3m III–V semiconductor** with coherently oriented tetrahedra. Its arsenide bonding and polar ordering make it a strong prospect relative to the phosphide analogues. |
| 3 | **c038** | Tl₃SbS₃ | A polar **R3m** structure containing aligned SbS₃ pyramids and lone-pair-active cations. The close training analogue Tl₃AsS₃ already reaches 44.8 pm/V; the softer Sb–S chemistry supports a higher prediction. |
| 4 | **c030** | CdSiP₂ | A noncentrosymmetric **I-42d chalcopyrite** with an ordered tetrahedral network. Training ZnSiP₂ reaches 51.4 pm/V; the more polarizable Cd–P bonding makes this a strong candidate for enhancement. |
| 5 | **c090** | K₇TaAs₄ | **Pmn2₁**, nearly isostructural with training K₇NbAs₄ (68.8 pm/V). Its similarly oriented metal–As tetrahedra provide particularly direct structural support for a large response. |

These are screening predictions, not calculated SHG tensors. The fourth and fifth positions are less certain than the leading selections.

Final: c073, c055, c038, c030, c090

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, pickle, warnings, math
from pymatgen.core import Element
from ase.data import covalent_radii
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
with open('/work/structures.pkl','rb') as f: structures=pickle.load(f)
info=pd.read_pickle('/work/structure_info.pkl')
nonmetals={'H','B','C','N','O','F','Si','P','S','Cl','Ge','As','Se','Br','Sb','Te','I'}
alkali={'Li','Na','K','Rb','Cs'}
alkaline={'Be','Mg','Ca','Sr','Ba'}
# Atom properties; anion/cation statistics are separated using the most electronegative species.
props={}
for e in set(e for s in structures for e in s.composition.elements):
 data={'Z':e.Z,'X':e.X or 0,'row':e.row,'group':e.group,'mass':float(e.atomic_mass),
 'radius':float(e.atomic_radius or covalent_radii[e.Z]),'rcov':covalent_radii[e.Z],
 'ionization':e.ionization_energy or 0,'affinity':e.electron_affinity or 0,'mendeleev':e.mendeleev_no,
 'molarvol':float(e.data.get('Molar volume',0)),
 'valence':e.group if e.group<3 else (e.group-10 if e.group>12 else 2),
 'metal':int(e.is_metal),'dmetal':int(e.is_transition_metal),'alkali':int(str(e) in alkali),
 'alkaline':int(str(e) in alkaline),'lonepair':int(str(e) in ['Ge','Sn','Sb','As','Bi','Tl','Pb']),
 'chalcogen':int(e.group==16),'pnictogen':int(e.group==15),'halogen':int(e.group==17)}
 for orbital in 'sp':
  data['orb_'+orbital]=e.atomic_orbitals.get(str(e.row)+orbital,0)
 props[e]=data

rows=[]
for si,s in enumerate(structures):
 d={}; elements=list(s.composition.elements); fractions=np.array([s.composition.get_atomic_fraction(e) for e in elements]); n=len(s)
 d['nelements']=len(elements);d['entropy']=-sum(fractions*np.log(fractions))
 for e in elements:d['frac_'+str(e)]=s.composition.get_atomic_fraction(e)
 # Separate conventional anions and cations. Pnictogens are anions only without chalcogens/halogens.
 aset=[e for e in elements if e.group in [16,17] or str(e) in ['N','C']]
 if not aset:aset=[e for e in elements if e.X==max(x.X for x in elements)]
 for scope,es in [('all',elements),('an',aset),('cat',[e for e in elements if e not in aset])]:
  if not es:es=elements
  w=np.array([s.composition.get_atomic_fraction(e) for e in es]); w/=sum(w)
  for prop in props[es[0]]:
   v=np.array([props[e][prop] for e in es]); avg=w@v
   d[scope+'_'+prop+'_mean']=avg
   if prop in ['Z','X','row','group','radius','rcov','ionization','affinity','valence','orb_s','orb_p','mass','mendeleev']:
    d[scope+'_'+prop+'_std']=np.sqrt(w@((v-avg)**2));d[scope+'_'+prop+'_min']=min(v);d[scope+'_'+prop+'_max']=max(v)
 for p in props[e]:
  d['diff_'+p]=d['an_'+p+'_mean']-d['cat_'+p+'_mean']
 for g in range(1,19):d['group_'+str(g)]=sum(f for e,f in zip(elements,fractions) if e.group==g)
 for g in range(1,8):d['row_'+str(g)]=sum(f for e,f in zip(elements,fractions) if e.row==g)
 d['stoich_max']=max(fractions);d['stoich_min']=min(fractions)
 d['vpa']=s.volume/n;d['density']=float(s.density);d['nsite']=n
 d['density_bonds']=1/d['vpa'];d['packing_cov']=sum(f*4*np.pi/3*covalent_radii[e.Z]**3 for e,f in zip(elements,fractions))/d['vpa']
 d['sgnum']=info.iloc[si].sgnum
 for pg in info.pg.unique(): d['pg_'+pg]=int(info.iloc[si].pg==pg)
 d['polar']=int(info.iloc[si].pg in ['1','2','m','mm2','3','3m','4','4mm','6','6mm'])
 a,b,c=s.lattice.abc;d['ratio_ab']=a/b;d['ratio_bc']=b/c;d['ratio_ca']=c/a
 d['angle_alpha'],d['angle_beta'],d['angle_gamma']=s.lattice.angles
 # directed nearest-neighbor bonds, lower to higher electronegativity (unique).
 ctr,nbr,img,dist=s.get_neighbor_list(5.5)
 xyz=s.cart_coords[nbr]+img@s.lattice.matrix-s.cart_coords[ctr]
 vec=xyz/dist[:,None]
 en=np.array([site.specie.X for site in s]);zs=np.array([site.specie.Z for site in s]);groups=np.array([site.specie.group for site in s])
 rads=covalent_radii[zs]
 mindist=np.array([min(dist[ctr==i]) for i in range(n)])
 for method in ['min','cov']:
  select=(dist<1.25*mindist[ctr]) if method=='min' else (dist<1.2*(rads[ctr]+rads[nbr]))
  local_stats=[]
  for i in range(n):
   sel=select&(ctr==i); ds=dist[sel];vs=vec[sel]
   if not len(ds):local_stats.append([0]*6);continue
   angle=vs@vs.T;off=angle[~np.eye(len(vs),dtype=bool)]
   tetra=np.mean((off+1/3)**2) if len(off) else 0
   t=np.einsum('ni,nj,nk->ijk',vs,vs,vs)/len(vs)
   local_stats.append([len(ds),np.mean(ds),np.std(ds)/np.mean(ds),tetra,np.linalg.norm(t),np.linalg.norm(np.mean(vs,axis=0))])
  local_stats=np.array(local_stats)
  for scope,mask in [('all',np.ones(n,dtype=bool)),('cat',np.array([site.specie not in aset for site in s])),('an',np.array([site.specie in aset for site in s]))]:
   if not any(mask):continue
   for p,v in zip(['cn','bl','blstd','tetra','local3','local1'],local_stats[mask].T):
    for stat,fun in [('mean',np.mean),('std',np.std),('min',np.min),('max',np.max)]:d[method+'_'+scope+'_'+p+'_'+stat]=fun(v)
  # dipolar bond direction (heteropolar), sum and local coherence.
  select&=en[ctr]<en[nbr]
  u=vec[select];x=ctr[select];y=nbr[select];ds=dist[select]
  for group,mask in [('all',np.ones(len(ds),dtype=bool)),('covalent',(groups[x]>10)&(groups[x]<16)),('ionic',(groups[x]<3)),('metal',np.array([s[int(i)].specie.is_transition_metal for i in x])),('pblock',(groups[x]>=13)&(groups[x]<16))]:
   if not any(mask):continue
   us=u[mask];xs=x[mask];ys=y[mask];ds1=ds[mask]
   for weight,w in [('unit',np.ones(len(us))),('Xdiff',en[ys]-en[xs]),('length3',ds1**3),('length-3',ds1**-3)]:
    t=np.einsum('n,ni,nj,nk->ijk',w,us,us,us)
    local=np.stack([np.einsum('n,ni,nj,nk->ijk',w[xs==i],us[xs==i],us[xs==i],us[xs==i]) for i in set(xs)])
    pre=method+'_'+group+'_'+weight
    d[pre+'_norm']=np.linalg.norm(t)/n
    d[pre+'_max']=abs(t).max()/n
    d[pre+'_trace']=np.linalg.norm(np.einsum('ijj->i',t))/n
    d[pre+'_coherence']=np.linalg.norm(t)/(sum(np.linalg.norm(t1) for t1 in local)+1e-12)
    d[pre+'_density']=np.linalg.norm(t)/s.volume
 d['Xionic']=1-np.exp(-.25*d['diff_X']**2)
 rows.append(d)
 if si%50==0:print('done',si,flush=True)
x=pd.DataFrame(rows).fillna(0)
x.to_pickle('/work/features.pkl')
print(x.shape)

 cols=sets[fset];xt=x[cols].values

 'radius':float(e.atomic_radius or covalent_radii[e.Z]),'rcov':covalent_radii[e.Z],
 'ionization':e.ionization_energy or 0,'affinity':e.electron_affinity or 0,'mendeleev':e.mendeleev_no,

rows=[]

 # Separate conventional anions and cations. Pnictogens are anions only without chalcogens/halogens.
 aset=[e for e in elements if e.group in [16,17] or str(e) in ['N','C']]
 if not aset:aset=[e for e in elements if e.X==max(x.X for x in elements)]
 for scope,es in [('all',elements),('an',aset),('cat',[e for e in elements if e not in aset])]:
  if not es:es=elements

  for prop in props[es[0]]:
   v=np.array([props[e][prop] for e in es]); avg=w@v
   d[scope+'_'+prop+'_mean']=avg
   if prop in ['Z','X','row','group','radius','rcov','ionization','affinity','valence','orb_s','orb_p','mass','mendeleev']:

 for g in range(1,8):d['row_'+str(g)]=sum(f for e,f in zip(elements,fractions) if e.row==g)

 d['vpa']=s.volume/n;d['density']=float(s.density);d['nsite']=n

 d['sgnum']=info.iloc[si].sgnum

 d['polar']=int(info.iloc[si].pg in ['1','2','m','mm2','3','3m','4','4mm','6','6mm'])
 a,b,c=s.lattice.abc;d['ratio_ab']=a/b;d['ratio_bc']=b/c;d['ratio_ca']=c/a
 d['angle_alpha'],d['angle_beta'],d['angle_gamma']=s.lattice.angles
 # directed nearest-neighbor bonds, lower to higher electronegativity (unique).
 ctr,nbr,img,dist=s.get_neighbor_list(5.5)
 xyz=s.cart_coords[nbr]+img@s.lattice.matrix-s.cart_coords[ctr]
 vec=xyz/dist[:,None]
 en=np.array([site.specie.X for site in s]);zs=np.array([site.specie.Z for site in s]);groups=np.array([site.specie.group for site in s])
 rads=covalent_radii[zs]
 mindist=np.array([min(dist[ctr==i]) for i in range(n)])
 for method in ['min','cov']:
  select=(dist<1.25*mindist[ctr]) if method=='min' else (dist<1.2*(rads[ctr]+rads[nbr]))
  local_stats=[]
  for i in range(n):

   if not len(ds):local_stats.append([0]*6);continue
   angle=vs@vs.T;off=angle[~np.eye(len(vs),dtype=bool)]
   tetra=np.mean((off+1/3)**2) if len(off) else 0
   t=np.einsum('ni,nj,nk->ijk',vs,vs,vs)/len(vs)
   local_stats.append([len(ds),np.mean(ds),np.std(ds)/np.mean(ds),tetra,np.linalg.norm(t),np.linalg.norm(np.mean(vs,axis=0))])
  local_stats=np.array(local_stats)
  for scope,mask in [('all',np.ones(n,dtype=bool)),('cat',np.array([site.specie not in aset for site in s])),('an',np.array([site.specie in aset for site in s]))]:
   if not any(mask):continue
